name: RA2 Toolbox 1.0.39-pre.7
source: Current rendering branch: x64 external host with x86 GameRuntime and hook broker; Vulkan rendering is optional.
resources: Update package reuses existing assets/profiles/preprocessing runtime/engine
validation: Production x64 host/x86 runtime cross-compilation, 680 real Windows cross-bit ABI checks, PE/import/manifest checks, targeted portable CPU continuity and ordered replay execution. No Windows/game/GPU execution. Historical camera-native-rows digest fails on both HF28 baseline and recovery with identical current digests.
build_requirement: Zig 0.13.0; x86 paired build or x64 host with x86 runtime and broker.

settings.Display.BuildTimeTooltip: 1=original native sidebar tooltip adds quantized build time directly below price, plus active remaining/held/ready state; default1, independent of render upgrade

package_type: Architecture-labelled experimental update; exact output PE metadata is generated by verify_windows_outputs.py, not inferred from historical tracked output manifests
game_code_patching: Material replacement leaves native shroud/fog drawing code unchanged; older experimental modes remain available and may install existing managed patches.
input_entry: Manager WH_GETMESSAGE / WH_CALLWNDPROCRET; managed frame-commit notifications wake the existing message entry for coherent sampling, never dispatch commands in the observer
symbolic_original_interfaces: EventClass original constructors + SP DoList / MP OutList
DisplayClass::ScrollMap (0x4A9840), rate-scaled adapter for experimental scrolling
release_status: 1.0.39-pre.7 Hotfix29 rendering recovery candidate; single render owner, completed pixel handoff, no shared-image direct presentation; not game/GPU validated
frontend: Independent settings input queues; latest-layout snapshots; dependency gating; explicit key gestures; page-only wheel scrolling
technology_experiment: Native AddCameo + two local UI CanBuild limit-only callsite wrappers; native factories/events unchanged; no live purchase/netplay certification
calculation_locations: Fifteen tactical decision families selectable; native queries/events always GameRuntime; host planner and six value-only compute lanes run on persistent workers, with UI publication and original source deadlines.
player_control: Experimental shared control retained; current-player switching and enemy-building Sell disabled
refresh_experiment: Cursor high refresh enabled; scene/forced refresh and view zoom entries disabled
render_effect_coverage: See ANIMATION_RENDER_COVERAGE.md: GPU viewport batches now include laser/radiation/wave/pixel/glow/alpha and electric bolts. CPU replay remains available. Native A/Z and bit-exact pixels remain uncertified.
